name: wardrobewise
description: WardrobeWise - AI-powered Smart Virtual Wardrobe & Personal Fashion Assistant (monorepo root)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
